name: Google Gemini API
description: Build AI chat, multimodal generation, and other model-backed features.
keyInstructions: Create your own Google AI Studio API key.
limitations: Free-model limits depend on model, project and region; paid usage is separate.

name: GroqCloud API
description: Low-latency hosted inference through a developer API.
keyInstructions: Create an individual Groq API key in your console.
limitations: Free usage is rate-limited at the organization/model level.

name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
description: Access hosted AI inference models through provider-backed APIs.
keyInstructions: Create a personal Hugging Face access token.
limitations: Free users receive a small monthly credit allocation; additional inference can be billed.

name: OpenRouter Free Models API
description: Use selected free-rate-limited language models through a common API.
keyInstructions: Create your own OpenRouter key.
limitations: Free models may have rate, daily usage, uptime or availability limits.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Run supported AI models on Cloudflare infrastructure.
keyInstructions: Create a Cloudflare account and use project-scoped credentials or bindings.
limitations: Free neuron allocation exists, but not every model is eligible for free usage.

name: OpenAI API
description: Integrate hosted AI text, multimodal, and other model capabilities.
keyInstructions: Generate your own private project API key.
limitations: Usage is billed under the provider terms; do not assume ChatGPT Free includes API credits.

name: Anthropic Claude API
description: Build applications using Claude models via API.
keyInstructions: Create a private API key through your Anthropic Console.
limitations: API usage pricing and account eligibility depend on model and platform.

name: Shopify Storefront API
description: Build storefronts that retrieve products and collections and manage carts.
keyInstructions: Some storefront operations are tokenless; other operations use a store-scoped public or private token.
limitations: Requires access to a Shopify store. Some tokenless features are available; merchant plan costs may apply.

name: Shopify Admin GraphQL API
description: Manage authorized merchant data such as inventory, orders and products.
keyInstructions: Authorize a Shopify app with merchant-approved scopes and obtain its access token.
limitations: Not a public reusable key; store/app permissions, platform plans and API limits apply.

name: WordPress REST API
description: Read public WordPress content and perform authenticated site management actions.
keyInstructions: Public endpoints can be called without keys; writes require user authentication, e.g. Application Passwords.
limitations: WordPress software is open source; hosting, plugins and some services can cost money.

name: WooCommerce REST API
description: Connect a WooCommerce store to order, product and inventory integrations.
keyInstructions: Generate per-store read or write API credentials in WooCommerce settings.
limitations: Requires permission on a WooCommerce installation; never publish the Consumer Secret.

name: Resend Email API
description: Send transactional email from apps and approved domains.
keyInstructions: Generate a Resend API key in your account.
limitations: Free plan has sending limits and domain requirements. Never expose a server send key in the browser.

name: Google Maps Platform APIs
description: Add maps, geocoding, places, or routing features to apps.
keyInstructions: Create a restricted API key in Google Cloud and configure billing as required.
limitations: Per-SKU monthly free-use caps vary; paid usage and billing settings can apply.

name: Supabase Database & Auth APIs
description: Add Postgres-backed data, authentication, and REST APIs to a project.
keyInstructions: Use a publishable key in public clients with RLS; keep secret keys on your backend.
limitations: Free tier has quotas; secure Row Level Security is required for user-owned data.

name: Stripe Payments API
description: Integrate payments and billing through provider-approved accounts.
keyInstructions: Create Stripe test/live keys in your dashboard; keep secret keys on the server.
limitations: Typically transaction fees apply; payment availability depends on country and account.

name: Cloudinary Media API
description: Manage images, transformations and media assets through an API.
keyInstructions: Create an account; private API secrets belong on the backend.
limitations: Free plan usage is subject to provider quotas and account terms.

name: GitHub REST API
description: Query repository metadata, issues, pull requests, or authorized accounts.
keyInstructions: Public endpoints may work without authentication; higher limits or private data need a token.
limitations: Never embed a privileged GitHub token in frontend JavaScript.

name: Firecrawl API
description: Convert public pages into structured information for permitted research and indexing.
keyInstructions: Create an account and generate your own API key.
limitations: Free trial credits and scraping permissions are subject to change; respect site terms.

name: Open-Meteo Weather API
description: Forecast, historical, air-quality and geocoding data for weather applications.
keyInstructions: No API key needed for eligible non-commercial use; use your own paid key for commercial services.
limitations: Free access is non-commercial, limited to 10,000 calls/day and has no uptime SLA. Attribution and licensing obligations apply.

name: Open Library API
description: Look up book, author, cover and reading metadata through public human-oriented APIs.
keyInstructions: Public book search endpoints do not normally require a key. Identify your application using User-Agent and a contact address.
limitations: Default requests are limited to around 1/second, identified clients around 3/second. Not intended as a third-party bulk database or high-traffic backend.

name: NASA Open APIs
description: Access NASA public astronomy, earth science and space imagery data APIs.
keyInstructions: Generate your own NASA API key or use DEMO_KEY for initial low-volume exploration.
limitations: Default personal key rate limit is 1,000 requests/hour; DEMO_KEY is restricted to 30/hour and 50/day per IP. Individual APIs may vary.

name: ExchangeRate-API Open Access
description: Retrieve daily currency reference exchange rates for small conversion applications.
keyInstructions: The open endpoint does not require an API key. A separate keyed free plan is available on the provider's website.
limitations: Open endpoint updates daily, is rate-limited, requires attribution and disallows redistribution; check commercial terms before integration.
